lines.say: Every night, your flat moves to a different city while you sleep.
Monday, a beach. Tuesday, snowy mountains. Wednesday, a city that never sleeps.
But your job is in one city. You are late every day. Then you are fired.
Your mom asks for your address. You send her a different one every day.
Night one hundred. You wake up in your own hometown. Then the flat starts shaking again.
Where would you want to wake up? Write it in the comments.
